supporting_span: $100,000 in the case of a joint return or a surviving spouse
$75,000 in the case of a head of household
$50,000 in the case of a married individual filing a separate return

rule: (NOT makes_joint_return(individual,spouse) AND NOT is_surviving_spouse(individual) AND NOT is_head_of_household(individual) AND NOT files_separate_return(individual)) -> applicable_amount_equals(individual,75000,taxable_year)
